properties.triggerCriteria: If your body does not have enough insulin, it can’t use glucose as a source of energy and will use fat instead. When your body uses fat for energy, your body makes chemicals called ketones.
properties.rationale: High levels of ketones in your blood can lead to a condition called diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) External link. DKA is a medical emergency that should be treated right away. DKA is most common in people with type 1 diabetes. Occasionally, DKA may affect people with type 2 diabetes who have lost their ability to produce insulin.
